name: fulcrum-ai-toolkit
description: AI skills for Fulcrum platform knowledge, app design and building, data events, reports, workflows, integrations, and field operations
author: Fulcrum (Spatial Networks)

interface.shortDescription: Build better Fulcrum apps with AI-guided skills
interface.longDescription: A collection of AI skills for building field data collection apps, extensions, reports, and workflows on the Fulcrum platform. Covers app design, data events, safety, workflow decomposition, app extensions, report building, solution documentation, and structured discovery interviews. Built for environmental, construction, utility, and inspection workflows.
capabilities: Canonical Fulcrum platform knowledge and capability guidance
Novice-friendly app discovery and connector-dependent build orchestration
Safety section recommendations for field work
Structured discovery interviews and solution documentation
